# Hedwig

> Check before your agent pays. Install Hedwig's local checker and review a proposed transaction before signing. Your wallet keeps control.

## Pages

- [Hedwig | Check before your agent pays](https://usehedwig.xyz/): Check before your agent pays. Install Hedwig's local checker and review a proposed transaction before signing. Your wallet keeps control.
- [About | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/about): Let your agent move money with a check before signing. Start with Hedwig's local checker. Solana assessments and reports are in development.
- [How it works | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/how-it-works): Put Hedwig before your agent's signing step. Try a local policy check. Solana scores and reports are in development.
- [Proof | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/proof): Inspect Hedwig's recorded Solana devnet checks, including a request over its amount limit and a revoked role.
- [Roadmap | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/roadmap): Try Hedwig's local checker today. Next are Solana assessments with one score for each action and a short report on request.
- [Team | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/team): Hi, I'm Gabe. I'm focused full time on Hedwig.
- [Docs | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/docs): Install Hedwig as a local MCP tool, set your payment rules and run a sample check. Your wallet or application controls signing.
- [Install Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents): Add an eval gate to your payment agent. Install Hedwig v0.4.2 locally and run a sample check without sending funds.

## Setup

These guides install v0.4.2. Newer changes on main may use different configuration.

- [Consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents.md): local setup and owner approval.
- [When to consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agentskill.md): payment checks through MCP.
- [Source](https://github.com/gabchess/hedwig)
